subject: Weekly MAP Check-in: Marketplace / Reseller purchase steps (AWS/Azure/GCP)
messages:
From: Sean Connors <sean.connors@cloudresell.io>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplace-ops@cloudresell.io
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + marketplace purchase steps for CloudResell / Redwood deal

Sergio / Aditya — thanks again for the demo yesterday. The procurement team asked for a concise MAP so they can track the marketplace purchase path across AWS, Azure and GCP. High level asks from our side:
- Clear purchase flow for each marketplace (listing vs. private offers vs. reseller flows)
- Timeline to availability in each marketplace (any gating items)
- Billing and invoicing expectations (reseller vs. direct)
- Evidence for security/compliance checks the procurement team requires

Can your team put together a one-page MAP we can include in our procurement packet? Also: we prefer to close via AWS or Azure marketplace but need clarity on whether reseller invoicing (CloudResell) is supported for the first 90 days.

Sean

2) Procurement docs needed (W‑9/SOW/Attestation + SOC evidence)

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP + marketplace purchase steps for CloudResell / Redwood deal — Weekly MAP checkpoint (notes + actions)

Thanks everyone for joining the 10:00 PT checkpoint. Below are concise meeting notes and the action-item list we agreed on. Attaching the working MAP checklist (MAP_Checklist_v2.xlsx) and our marketplace onboarding PDF. Please review and flag any gaps by EOD Wed.

Meeting notes (18 May 2026):
- Purpose: align on purchase path and close timeline for CloudResell pilot (Q2 close target).
- Consensus: Primary path = AWS Private Offer for quickest procurement; parallel submission to Azure Marketplace for listing (target Q3). GCP listing is lower priority but tracked.
- Billing: For first 90 days CloudResell can invoice customers (reseller flow) via private offer w/ resale arrangement; Redwood will invoice CloudResell at month end. Need reseller agreement clause to confirm.
- Security docs: Shared SOC 2 report (summary) + standard attestation acceptable for procurement initial review; full SOC available on request via secure link.

Action items (owners & due dates):
1) Update MAP checklist with exact procurement docs per marketplace — Owner: Monica Patel (redwood) — Due: 2026-05-20
2) Draft reseller billing clause and sample invoice flow — Owner: Aditya Rao (redwood) — Due: 2026-05-19
3) Submit private offer playbook for AWS to CloudResell Ops — Owner: Sergio Alvarez (redwood) — Due: 2026-05-21
4) CloudResell to confirm procurement timeline and internal approver list — Owner: Sean Connors (cloudresell) — Due: 2026-05-20
5) Upload signed NDA / procurement contact info to shared drive — Owner: Marketplace Ops (cloudresell) — Due: 2026-05-19

Attachments referenced: MAP_Checklist_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), AWS_Marketplace_Onboarding.pdf (pdf)

Next checkpoint: Friday 21 May 09:00 PT (15 minutes) — quick status & go/no-go on private offer submission.

Thanks,
Sergio

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, Sean Connors <sean.connors@cloudresell.io>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — draft reseller clause + invoice flow

Quick update on item 2 (reseller billing clause):
- Drafted a 2‑paragraph clause that permits Redwood to accept reseller invoices for the pilot period with monthly settlement. Will add a sample invoice layout showing PO reference and marketplace private offer ID.
- Sending the draft clause in the drive link (see related links). Monica will incorporate into the MAP checklist.

Two asks for CloudResell:
1) Please confirm the AP contact and whether your team needs Redwood to provide NET30 or NET45 terms in the reseller invoice.
2) If CloudResell prefers a consolidated invoice per customer vs. per-account, flag that now — it affects how we create the private offer metadata.

I’ll have a final clause ready for review by Friday morning.

Thanks — Aditya

From: Sean Connors <sean.connors@cloudresell.io>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, marketplace-ops@cloudresell.io
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — quick confirmation

Thanks team — confirming the following:
- AP contact: finance+cr@cloudresell.io (primary)
- CloudResell prefers NET30 for pilot invoices and consolidated invoices per customer are fine.
- We’ll route NDA and procurement contacts to the Drive folder; Marketplace Ops will upload by EOD today.

Next steps for Redwood per our action list: please upload the private-offer submission bundle to the shared drive and I’ll confirm once procurement starts the internal review. We remain on track for a week-to-week MAP.

Sean
